description: This file contains Discord event listeners and handlers for a plugin system, including message, reaction, presence, and thread update events, with logging and timeout management.

classes.name: DiscordMessageListener
classes.description: Listener for handling Discord message creation events, executing a provided handler asynchronously.

classes.name: DiscordReactionListener
classes.description: Listener for handling Discord reaction addition events, executing a provided handler.

classes.name: DiscordReactionRemoveListener
classes.description: Listener for handling Discord reaction removal events, executing a provided handler.

classes.name: DiscordPresenceListener
classes.description: Listener for handling Discord presence update events, updating user presence state.

classes.name: DiscordThreadUpdateListener
classes.description: Listener for handling Discord thread update events, particularly thread archiving, and resetting sessions.

methods.name: formatListenerContextValue
methods.description: Formats a value for logging context, converting to string if applicable.

methods.name: formatListenerContextSuffix
methods.description: Creates a suffix string for logging context entries.

methods.name: logSlowDiscordListener
methods.description: Logs a warning if a Discord event listener exceeds a threshold duration.

methods.name: runDiscordListenerWithSlowLog
methods.description: Runs a Discord event handler with timeout and slow log management.

methods.name: registerDiscordListener
methods.description: Registers a new listener if not already registered.

methods.name: handleDiscordReactionEvent
methods.description: Processes a Discord reaction event, including authorization and notification logic.

methods.name: authorizeDiscordReactionIngress
methods.description: Checks if a Discord reaction ingress is allowed based on policies and permissions.
